scope: Proposition 3.10 (Continuum fermion martingales) of the manuscript “Thermal FK–Ising interfaces and massive SLE” (preprints/Thermal-FK-Ising-interfaces-and-massive-SLE-October-5-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 223 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 c2a2a4a8b4213752), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 15. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Every subsequential curve law of Proposi- tion 3.7 has a joint realization with a complex field Mt(w), w ∈ Ot, such that Mt(w)2 = Dht(w), ¯ ∂Mt + imMt = 0. The field is continuous locally in space and time before swallowing, and is smooth in its spatial variable. On every protected compact subset of the live domain, after localization, Mt(w) is a continuous martingale in the joint natural filtration of the curve and field. In particular it is a continuous local martingale at each fixed point before its swallowing time.
